about: How the merchant knows things (Plans/map_play.md: only what you know). 'sure': how sure each way of learning is when learned (0-1); talk loses 'per_hop' for each further mouth. 'half_life_days': how fast each kind of knowledge goes stale (half as sure after this many days; prices: the same month the AI traders use). 'error': the share a told price may be off by (fixed when heard). 'keep': notes older than 'all_days' are thinned to one a month per port, and after 'season_after_years' to one a season. 'words': the sureness at which the map says sure, likely, doubtful (below: stale).
_word: THE WORD ON THE ITEM (Design/research_trade_seasons_and_hints.md 6.1): the one line under a good. The first rule that fires wins: hard news younger than news_days; a price seen younger than seen_days; a price told younger than told_days; talk and rumour, and anything else noted younger than known_days; the season; ships that left for there in the last ahead_days; the law; nothing known. A price is said against the price where she lies (or where she last saw the good priced): within same_within of it 'much the same', beyond that 'more' or 'less', and 'far more' or 'far less' where carrying the good between the two would pay (the market's spread and the toll: worked out, not a number here). A price she saw within seen_days shows its figure; one told by a man who saw it himself, or her own older sight, shows 'about' and a rough figure (told_figure false: a word only, as all talk is); talk through more mouths is a word only. Where there is nothing to say it against, the old words stand: 'well' when the market pays pays_well times the good's table value or more, 'poorly' at pays_poorly times or less, else 'the usual'. The words themselves are in wording_793.json ('word').
